add_library(BugTrap UNKNOWN IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(
    BugTrap PROPERTIES

    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${BugTrap_DIR}/"
    IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS "DEBUG;RELWITHDEBINFO"
    
    MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_RELWITHDEBINFO RelWithDebInfo
    MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_DEBUG Debug  
    
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG "${BugTrap_DIR}/BugTrapUD-x64.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELWITHDEBINFO "${BugTrap_DIR}/BugTrapU-x64.lib"

)
